Your feelings of hurt and resentment are valid. Five years of emotional starvation leaves deep marks, and one year of distance doesn't automatically erase that. It's okay to acknowledge that you need more than words — you need consistent, sustained effort and real accountability. Consider having an honest conversation with him about what you've been feeling, ideally with the support of a couples counselor who can help you both navigate this. You deserve to be heard and cared for, not just when it's convenient for him.
